nd030990f64.headline: S&P reaffirms Australia's AAA rating but warns of possible downgrade - Diário do Grande ABC
nd030990f64.summary: S&P has reaffirmed Australia's AAA credit rating but issued a warning about a potential downgrade in the future.
nd030990f64.why: Credit ratings affect borrowing costs and investor confidence; Australia's AAA rating is a key indicator of economic strength and fiscal management.
nd030990f64.why_moved: The reaffirmation supports Australia's creditworthiness, while the downgrade warning introduces uncertainty about future fiscal and economic conditions.
